name: Stick Figure Doodle
description: Minimal, witty hand-drawn stick-figure comics — black wobbly pen lines on off-white paper, one accent colour and hand-lettered text. A small recurring cast walks, points, shrugs, panics and talks in sync with the voice next to deadpan doodles, hand-drawn graphs with sarcastic labels, labelled arrows and zooming scale comparisons. The science-and-philosophy webcomic explainer look.
fonts: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", "Comic Sans MS", "Chalkboard SE", "Comic Neue", "Noto Sans", cursive
